note: G8 M4: this transform deleted the very blocks GOTO, M99 P and G71 P-Q point at, and reported nothing at all — strictly more destructive than renumber, which at least warned. The removal itself is what the command means, so it still happens; it now asks first and lists every line left pointing at a block number that is gone. M98 P1010 names a program, not a block, and is not listed.
